facts.fact: StackAdapt announced it was named the winner of the 2025 Programmatic Impact Award for Best Use of AI in a Campaign, presented by AdExchanger.
facts.quote: named the winner of the 2025 Programmatic Impact Award for Best Use of AI in a Campaign

facts.fact: StackAdapt's winning entry was a collaboration with Popeyes that used Page Context AI to run a privacy-safe, highly-targeted campaign in the UK market (vendor's own description).
facts.quote: leveraging Page Context AI to launch a privacy-safe, highly-targeted campaign in the competitive UK market

facts.fact: AdExchanger's Programmatic Impact Awards are described by the vendor as dedicated solely to excellence in programmatic media.
facts.quote: the Programmatic Impact Awards are dedicated solely to excellence in programmatic media

facts.fact: The award was to be celebrated live at Programmatic I/O: Innovate in Las Vegas on Tuesday, May 20 (2025).
facts.quote: The award will be celebrated live at Programmatic I/O: Innovate on Tuesday, May 20, in Las Vegas

facts.fact: StackAdapt's own claim is that its AI-powered platform runs 465 billion automated optimizations per second (vendor claim, not third-party verified).
